summary: Strict anchor cannot claim broad 3GPP/6G conformance while enabled mandatory blocks are partial or unavailable
evidence: Runtime truth contract now fails strict runs when result_issue_registry.csv contains active critical/high/medium blockers, exports ActiveMandatoryIssueCount/ActiveCriticalIssueCount/ActiveHighIssueCount/ActiveMediumIssueCount in truth_contract_summary.csv, propagates ScenarioObjectiveOk and StandardsConformanceOk through scenario summary/manifest surfaces, and keeps run completion separate from conformance eligibility.
impact: Strict runs with active mandatory issues no longer pass conformance gates
recommended_fix: Keep active issue registry rows mandatory for strict profiles and only mark fixed/verified rows as resolved

summary: Configured fixed operating point can collapse to lower effective rank/modulation/MCS without failing scenario objective
evidence: Effective operating-point summary preserves configured nominal DL/UL rank/layers/modulation/MCS separately from runtime histograms and configured-match rates. Strict fixed operating-point scenarios now fail ScenarioObjectiveOk when DL/UL ConfiguredMatchRate falls below the required threshold, and truth_contract_summary.csv exports RequiredConfiguredMatchRate plus DL/UL match rates.
impact: Configured scenario targets can no longer silently pass when runtime trials collapse to a lower effective operating point
recommended_fix: Keep adaptive CQI-driven runs exempt from fixed operating-point exact-match gates; for fixed anchors require configured/effective match evidence from raw trials

summary: SIB1/RRC path is not waveform-decoded ASN.1
evidence: Fixed: SIB1 now generates and recovers a strict SSB/PBCH/MIB -> Type0 CSS PDCCH -> PDSCH/DL-SCH -> constrained ASN.1 SIB1 waveform path. SI-RNTI 65535 is used for DCI CRC masking while PDCCH physical scrambling uses nRNTI=0 for common search space; stale unsupported skip was removed from the positive test.
impact: Residual scope is the intentionally constrained anchor ASN.1 profile rather than full TS 38.331 ASN.1 coverage
recommended_fix: Extend ASN.1 profile/IE coverage as new scenarios require; do not reintroduce payloadStruct shortcuts

summary: PRACH is preamble detection only and not full four-step random access
evidence: Prompt audit item 4: PRACH simplified waveform preamble detection gate, not full RA.
recommended_fix: Implement MSG1-MSG4 with RA-RNTI/RAR/contention resolution evidence or fail strict anchor

summary: Restricted-set PRACH support and NCS validation are not complete
evidence: Strict PRACH mini anchor now uses real PRACH waveform generation/detection, long-sequence unrestricted/type A/type B N_CS validation, ZCZ/root-budget/collision/multi-occasion/false-alarm/missed-detection/timing/frequency/negative/oracle evidence, and a truth gate that rejects skipped/proxy/simplified PRACH rows.
recommended_fix: Keep unsupported PRACH profiles fail-closed and expand format coverage only with waveform evidence

summary: PDCCH detection lacked negative blind-decode and false-alarm evidence
evidence: Strict PDCCH mini anchor now uses real nrDCIEncode/nrPDCCH/nrPDCCHResources/nrPDCCHDecode/nrDCIDecode waveform execution through the repo Tx/Rx path, exports CORESET/search-space config, candidate rows, DCI field equality, decoded-grant validation, wrong-RNTI/no-signal/corruption/wrong-format/invalid-grant negative evidence, false-alarm and low-SNR sweeps, and an oracle guard. The truth contract rejects old all-one metric-only PDCCH rows for strict PDCCH.
impact: Control decode quality can be overclaimed if old study rows are reused
recommended_fix: Keep unsupported DCI/RNTI/search-space combinations fail-closed; expand DCI 1_1/0_1 and SI/RA integration only with equivalent waveform evidence.

summary: DL PDSCH can have high BLER/BER while overall run is OK
evidence: DL PDSCH RX now exports strict receiver-stage evidence from the executed waveform receiver, including channel-estimation, PDSCH resource extraction, equalization, DL-SCH decode, LLR, and receiver-derived post-eq SINR flags. Raw BLER/BER objective artifacts are computed only from raw DL PDSCH trial rows; strict/no-proxy runs fail when BLER/BER thresholds, decode evidence, proxy/skipped checks, configured-vs-effective MCS/modulation/layer/rank matching, grant binding, MIMO reference, or Channel/RF reference gates fail.
impact: A degraded DL run with BLER around 0.43 or BER around 0.31 cannot remain ResultOk/ScenarioObjectiveOk=true under strict DL PDSCH objective thresholds. Fixed-anchor MCS/modulation/rank/layer collapse is explicitly reported as an objective failure.
recommended_fix: Keep scheduled-control DL blocked by AUD-PDCCH-001 unless PDSCH rows reference decoded PDCCH grants; keep advanced MIMO/ChannelRF/MAC-HARQ dependencies scoped to their own issue rows

summary: UL goodput summary can disagree with raw PUSCH/grant evidence
evidence: Raw-derived KPI reconstruction now writes formula registry, source manifest, schema audit, reconstruction, row-contribution, HARQ trace, direction-isolation, legacy-alias, known-bug, unit-conversion, duration-source, and objective-binding artifacts. Goodput_UL_max_Mbps is generated from Direction=UL raw rows only; the audited DL 40.137091 Mbps versus UL 7.952 Mbps copy bug is covered by a regression guard.
impact: Charts and summary no longer use DL aggregate/link KPI values for UL legacy goodput aliases
recommended_fix: Keep dashboards and future KPI cards reading canonical KPI reconciliation artifacts; do not mark full UL receiver or MAC/HARQ procedure conformance from this KPI accounting fix

summary: UL post-equalization SINR can pin near 0 dB despite higher receiver Hest SINR
evidence: Receiver-stage evidence gate implemented in working tree: PUSCH_Rx now validates DM-RS channel-estimation, PUSCH resource extraction, equalization, UL-SCH decode evidence, finite LLRs, and receiver-derived post-eq SINR before strict rows can count. ul_pusch_trials.csv exports StrictReceiverEvidenceOk, ChannelEstimateAttempted/Available, EqualizationAttempted/Available, ULSCHDecodeAttempted/Available, LLRAvailable/Finite, PostEqSINRAvailable/ReceiverDerived, SINRValidationStatus/Reason, and rejects configured/proxy/fallback SINR sources.
impact: Scheduler/CQI no longer receive strict UL rows with missing post-eq receiver evidence; remaining closure items are full strict mini scenario artifacts, high-rank/256QAM fixed-anchor validation, and the complete negative fault matrix.
recommended_fix: Complete the remaining AUD-UL-SINR-001 acceptance matrix before changing this row to fixed

summary: TRS may pass when timing detection/tracking was not attempted
evidence: Strict TRS mini anchor now derives NZP-CSI-RS/TRS resources from resolved YAML, executes waveform mapping/channel/timing/CFO/channel-estimation checks, exports positive/negative/sweep/oracle artifacts, and the coupled runtime gate rejects TRS rows unless detection, timing, frequency/CFO, and channel-estimation evidence are explicitly attempted and available.
impact: Tracking-reference success can no longer be accepted from metric-only or skipped TRS rows in strict TRS-required runtime gating
recommended_fix: Keep unsupported TRS profiles fail-closed and expand multi-port/advanced TRS only with equivalent waveform evidence.

summary: SRS success can hide partial-carrier coverage
evidence: Strict SRS mini anchor now derives nrSRSConfig from resolved YAML, generates real nrSRS symbols/indices/waveform, extracts SRS at the gNB from received UL grids, estimates UL channel from SRS REs, gates full-carrier claims on actual PRB coverage, exports trigger/coverage/negative/sweep/oracle artifacts, and the truth contract rejects skipped/proxy/unavailable/partial-claimed-full SRS rows.
impact: UL channel-sounding claims can no longer pass strict SRS validation without waveform detection/channel-estimation/full-coverage evidence
recommended_fix: Keep unsupported SRS resource types/usages/hopping/port profiles fail-closed and expand only with equivalent waveform evidence.

summary: Configured channel/RF impairments could be claimed without configured-vs-applied waveform evidence
evidence: Strict Channel/RF mini anchor now derives a validated config from YAML, rejects bare TDL/CDL family profiles, builds topology/geometry tables, applies TR 38.901 large-scale pathloss/shadow/O2I to waveform samples, executes AWGN/TDL/CDL channel realizations with path gains and snapshots, applies Doppler, waveform-overlap interference, thermal noise from bandwidth/noise figure, and RF CFO/phase-noise/IQ/PA/timing/quantization to samples, then exports positive/negative configured-vs-applied rows, oracle guard rows, downstream channel-reference rows, and a truth-contract summary. Sample-clock offset requests now fail closed until a real SCO resampling model is implemented.
impact: Channel and RF tables can no longer pass strict Channel/RF validation from configured labels alone
recommended_fix: Keep unsupported channel/RF combinations fail-closed; production PDSCH/PUSCH trial-table lineage must be expanded separately with equivalent ChannelRealizationId/RFImpairmentChainId evidence.

summary: Antenna/MIMO/rank evidence does not prove advertised multi-antenna rank anchor
evidence: Strict MIMO evidence export now separates physical antenna counts, RF chains, antenna ports, DM-RS ports, configured rank/layers/modulation/MCS, scheduled/transmitted rank/layers, receiver-estimated rank, and effective decoded rank/layers. Effective decoded rank is reconstructed only from raw DL/UL trial rows with CRC/decode/receiver usability and finite per-layer post-equalization evidence. Strict mode now fails when fixed-anchor rank/layers/MCS/modulation collapse, when physical/RF/port support is insufficient, when multi-layer rows lack PMI/precoder or beam-source lineage, or when nominal configuration is the only evidence.
impact: Scenario rank/beam claims can no longer pass from nominal labels or silently collapse to lower effective runtime behavior
recommended_fix: Keep unsupported MIMO profiles fail-closed; expand true waveform-layer tests for advanced codebooks, high UL rank, MU-MIMO, multi-panel, hybrid FR2, polarization/XPR, and CoMP only with equivalent runtime artifacts.
